# agenthand — reviewer brief

agenthand is an MCP server for AI agents that work with real rooms,
objects, and property. Three tools: identify (what is this, what
condition, what is it worth), cut_out (pixel-exact extraction), and
draw (a new background composited under the untouched product —
Fidelity Lock: the product pixels never change, and a hash receipt
proves it).

## Verify everything: the Proof Graph

Every verified run, receipt, model call, and demo-film chapter is in
one rusqlite evidence graph, queried through the product itself. It
is knowledge graph engineering applied to build evidence: the nodes
and edges are derived from the data's own foreign keys at import,
never drawn by hand.

- `agenthand evidence verify --all` — re-checks every receipt in the
  Proof Graph against the shipped files; one verdict line per claim.
- `agenthand evidence chapter <m:ss>` — deep link from any moment in
  the demo film to the chapter at that timestamp and its claim.
- `agenthand evidence export <dir>` — writes a judge pack: the
  evidence database, every resolvable receipt file, and a manifest
  with the receipts root, in one folder.
- `agenthand evidence trace <claim|chapter|receipt>` — walks the
  graph from a film timestamp or a claim to the run, the receipt,
  and its sha256.
- `agenthand evidence graph --format mermaid` — the whole graph,
  rendered.
- No keys needed: `conformance/` holds a frozen offline replay of a
  real run (580,613 pixels checked, 0 changed) that verifies locally.
- Receipts root: `1179530968c27879e3d84aa5475998a475cba64ba5b95f1823a8e7310174ecc3`
  — one hash pins the whole evidence set; recompute it with
  `agenthand evidence root` and compare.

## Layout

- `README.md` — setup (including adding your own Meta Model API and
  Baseten keys), the model-calls table, the Proof Graph section.
- `JUDGING.md` — rubric-mapped index: each criterion points at the
  exact files, commands, and numbers that speak to it.
- `evidence/` — the Proof Graph database (SQLite via rusqlite).
- `reference/` — the Python reference implementation (the QC build;
  the Rust build is the product; the two cross-verify).
- `conformance/` — the parity harness and the frozen replay package.

## Runtime models (all Meta)

- identify: Muse Spark 1.3 · cut_out: SAM 3.1 · draw (plate only):
  Muse Image 1.0 · narration: Muse Spark Open (via Baseten).
  No non-Meta AI model is called at runtime.
